answer: A payout is split thus 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The horizon schedule is applied in harbor and echo shows each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3301 identities would post 824 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
